data.content_ref: inline:The problem explicitly asks 'which of the two properties does an append-only event log actually require of its writers.' SRC_002 answers 'neither safety nor idempotence of individual writers' and redirects to commutativity of concurrent appends and idempotence of the deduplication layer. This does not answer the question as stated: the question frames the requirement as a choice between idempotent and safe as applied to the log's writers. By pivoting to systemic/infrastack properties (dedup layer, broker sequencing), SRC_002 fails to identify the writer-level property the problem demands. Its own countercondition concedes: 'If the problem specifically asks about writer-level properties (as RFC 9110 scopes them), this systemic answer may not directly address the question.' The problem does ask about writer-level properties, so by its own admission the answer is off-target.
